AVI Global Trust plc (the "Company")

Buy-back of own securities

The Company announces that on 4 September 2026 it bought back 210,000 O rdinary shares of 2p each in the capital of the Company (SEDOL: BLH3CY6 / ISIN: GB00BLH3CY60), representing approximately 0.050% of the issued Ordinary share capital, at a price of 264.81 pence per Ordinary share (lowest price per share 264.00 pence, highest price per share 265.00 pence) . The Ordinary shares bought back will be cancelled.

Following cancellation the Ordinary shares in issue, shares held in treasury, and the Total Voting Rights of the Company will be as follows:

Number of Ordinary Shares in issue
415,969,755
Number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury
21,873,084
Total Voting Rights
394,096,671
